# Aniruddha Ganesh

> Personal portfolio of Aniruddha Ganesh, a product-focused software engineer working across frontend architecture, developer experience, and AI-powered products.

The portfolio is published at [profile.indic-games.in](https://profile.indic-games.in). It presents Aniruddha's background, selected work, technical toolkit, and contact profiles.

## About

Aniruddha builds interfaces for complex systems, including enterprise AI products with knowledge ingestion and retrieval, agent workflows, streaming conversations, document processing, and workspace administration. His experience includes frontend and full-stack product engineering, TypeScript and React, Node.js systems, and design systems.

## Selected work

- **ReN3** — Enterprise AI platform. Frontend contributions include streaming chat, knowledge-source flows, workspace administration, citation navigation, file exploration, and a multi-format file viewer.
- **Comake** — Knowledge-platform ecosystem. Frontend architecture and interfaces for schema and entity management, configurable data views, page builders, workflows, and shared platform services. Work also included AIMeGo, an AI-powered travel assistant sold to the City of Atlanta.
- **ClinchIt** — Enterprise AI sales platform for account intelligence, conversational agents, RFP responses, call assistance, and analytics. Full-stack work included streaming chat, agent tools, sales metrics, and integrations.
- **Lexsitus** — Multilingual international criminal law information platform. Full-stack work included migration from Angular to Next.js, content modeling, APIs, search, reading lists, and localization.
- **Indic Games** — Personal project: a collection of games inspired by Indian knowledge systems, built with React, Zustand, Express, Socket.IO, and Contentful.
- **Chet** — E-learning platform with expert-curated learning collections; frontend feature work and administration tooling.
- **Playground** — Creator platform for connecting with audiences and promoting events, merchandise, podcasts, and content.
- **REBNY Lease Store** — Application for creating, managing, and generating customized commercial and residential leases.

The portfolio also describes work on Chardan, Humans, TrueNose, and Foundation.

## Technical toolkit

TypeScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, Express, GraphQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Amazon S3, AWS, Ubuntu, Pulumi, Zustand, and Socket.IO.
